abstract: Oversees acoustic isolation test compliance and overhead lighting truss payload engineering
system_message:
You are the Audiovisual production director (AVP). Your responsibilities include overseeing acoustic isolation test compliance and overhead lighting truss payload engineering, as well as tracking auxiliary power generation logs across candidate host arenas.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Oversees acoustic isolation test compliance and overhead lighting truss payload engineering（SOUND）
information_points.content:
AVP-SOUND-3SU：For Docklands International Pavilion, the acoustical engineering assessment confirms that acoustic isolation compliance approved is true between the main tournament bowl and broadcast commentary booths, while the AV production technical rider specifies a lighting truss structural payload of 80 t.
AVP-SOUND-O6C：For Meridian Grand Velodrome, the acoustical engineering report indicates that acoustic isolation compliance approved is false between the main tournament bowl and broadcast commentary booths, while the AV production technical rider calculates a lighting truss structural payload of 60 t.
AVP-SOUND-90T：For Riverside Exhibition Coliseum, the acoustical engineering assessment confirms that acoustic isolation compliance approved is true between the main tournament bowl and broadcast commentary booths, and the lighting truss structural payload is rated at 60 t.

information_points.title: Auxiliary power generation（POWER）
information_points.content:
AVP-POWER-JB6：According to the generator maintenance log for Docklands International Pavilion, the dedicated broadcast backup plant provides a standby generator runtime of 48 h at continuous full rated prime load.
AVP-POWER-2AC：According to the generator maintenance log for Riverside Exhibition Coliseum, the dedicated broadcast backup plant provides a standby generator runtime of 24 h at continuous full rated prime load.
AVP-POWER-FQF：According to the generator maintenance log for Meridian Grand Velodrome, the dedicated broadcast backup plant provides a standby generator runtime of 36 h at continuous full rated prime load.
